name: JavDB v3
deviceFindingsFromTest1: global inline search occupies too much vertical space and should become a dedicated search task
six primary tabs overflow to a meaningless top-level arrow on the target device
advanced category expansion exposes every dynamic tag group at once and creates an excessively long control wall
actor monthly ranking used a high-metadata one-column component despite having little metadata, causing large blank rows
continue-browsing cards exposed an unnecessary history overlay/status
More page looked like a disabled grey control matrix instead of a low-frequency settings/tool hub
detail and review pages retained legacy black-square section markers and technical-list visual hierarchy
external playback provider logos were oversized and consumed most of the viewport

changes.search: Remove global input from the main page. Add dedicated Search Hub with input, recent history, clear-history and actor/series/maker/director entry points; existing javdb3Search result route remains unchanged.
changes.navigation: Primary navigation is reduced to Discovery / Ranking / Category / Actor / My. Search is a dedicated page and More becomes a low-frequency page entered from My, eliminating the top-level overflow arrow.
changes.home: Quick task filters use compact chips and continue-browsing cards no longer inject release/history overlay metadata.
changes.category: Advanced filters use progressive disclosure: show one row per dynamic tag group and expand only the group being edited. Only one group is open at a time. Existing API filter semantics and same-page state changes remain unchanged.
changes.ranking: Movie rankings retain high-metadata vertical cards; actor monthly ranking switches to a three-column portrait grid with TOP labels.
changes.myMore: My remains the primary account/local-data hub and exposes one More entry. More is rebuilt as a dedicated low-frequency page with full-width tool rows and compact experience/maintenance controls.
changes.detail: Test-only result interception removes legacy blank blocks and black-square section markers, renames local movie action to local collection, and visually emphasizes More Playback without changing underlying detail API/action URLs. If Hiker does not allow result interception, it safely falls back to the original detail renderer.
changes.reviews: Test-only result interception removes legacy section markers, removes duplicate score text from metadata and shortens ISO timestamps to YYYY-MM-DD; underlying review loading/pagination remains unchanged.
changes.externalPlayback: Local Entry now re-enters the core overlay for javdb3ExternalPlay. Provider logos are replaced by compact real-provider actions, while official VIP/preview and official magnet links remain separate.

delivery.normalStartupForCode: local Entry + local UI1 + local UI2 + validated 3.9.44 local Runtime
delivery.sameScopeEval: Base Runtime core() evaluates Stable patches then UI1 then UI2 then page call in the same JDB scope

staticGate: shell outer JSON parsed before upload
shell pages JSON parsed before upload
existing javdb3Search route still calls custom('javdb3Search')
javdb3ExternalPlay is intentionally special-cased through core() so UI2 can override it
device: pending Test2 screenshots and interaction regression
notes: Built directly from the user's 2026-08-26 Test1 screenshots. Stable 3.9.42 and Latest remain untouched. Detail/review interception is intentionally Test-only and must be validated on the target Hiker build before promotion.
